messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE FIRED — p99 inference latency > 3s for hosted-api-prod (slo: p99 < 1.2s). alert_id=PD-8942

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Triggered incident INC-202303-8942, urgency=high, service=hosting-inference-prod. Escalation to level-1 oncall.

alex_cheng: acked (oncall). I'm looking. seeing spike in tail latencies across us-west and eu-west.

mike_w: +1, i'm pulling traces now. any recent deploys?

anika: no deploys in the last 45m from release bot. autoscaler logs show multiple failed scale-up attempts.

jules_ml: traces show KV cache miss ratio jumped from ~5% to ~72% around 12:04:22 UTC. large batches hitting cold KV shards.

alex_cheng: interesting — looks like a burst of long-context requests from a single customer pool (routed via api-key sk-prod-xx). Could be a training/ingestion job hitting hosted endpoint.

mike_w: pulling pod logs:
```
2026-03-14T12:04:18Z INF request=start id=... seq=2048 tokens=4096 route=/v1/chat
2026-03-14T12:04:19Z ERR kvcache: miss shard=17 key=sess-...
2026-03-14T12:04:20Z ERR runtime: oom-like queueing, enqueue_wait=1248ms
```

anika: autoscaler errors show quota temporarily exhausted in us-west-g4 pool. fallback to eu-west delayed due to routing sticky session policy.

sara_cs: CS alert: customer A reported UI timeouts and slow chat responses, multiple support tickets opened. impact: several customers experiencing degraded UX, no data loss.

jules_ml: model-serving metrics look healthy CPU/GPU, it's the memory pressure on KV shards and scheduler queueing. batch sizes peaked at 64 where typical is 8.

alex_cheng: mitigation proposal: 1) flip feature flag reduce-batch-size-to-8 for hosted-api (fast) 2) enable routing fallback to model-compat small-quant variant for non-critical requests 3) scale up reserved pool as immediate relief.

mike_w: ready to flip the flag. running the toggle in prod console now.

alex_cheng: doing toggle: `POST https://console/api/flags/toggle` payload `{ "flag": "auto_batch_limit", "value": 8 }`

pagerduty: Incident INC-202303-8942 acknowledged by alex_cheng.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Feature flag changed: auto_batch_limit -> 8 (user=alex_cheng, request_id=req-4432).

jules_ml: after flag flip, batch size distribution back to normal in ~30s, p95 improved. p99 still elevated due to queued KV cache rebuilds.

anika: enabling fallback routing for non-SLA traffic to model-compat-small. command: `./routesctl promote --from hosted-prod --to model-compat-small --selector=noncritical` (running)

sara_cs: I posted a short customer note in #support with status (degraded performance, mitigation in progress). No ETA yet; CS wants hourly updates.

mike_w: started manual cache-warm job for hot session keys from logs: `python tools/cache_warm.py --shard 17 --session-file /tmp/hot_sessions`

alex_cheng: autoscaler team reports quota was hit due to concurrent ephemeral burst from a tenant exceeding per-tenant throttle. I've opened a throttle rule to cap per-tenant burst at 200 concurrent requests.

jules_ml: p99 trending down but still at ~1.9s. we should watch for regressions after cache warms.

anika: creating short-lived override to relax sticky session policy to allow region fallback for this incident. Patch applied.

pagerduty: Escalation: alert routed to level-2 (anika) due to >15m unmitigated.

anika: investigating the root: it seems a customer load-generator hit production by mistake (bot misconfigured). reached out to account team to throttle them.

alex_cheng: summary for handoff to next oncall (end of this pager rotation):
- incident id: INC-202303-8942
- trigger: p99 latency > 3s caused by burst of large-batch requests and KV cache miss cascade
- mitigation applied: auto_batch_limit -> 8, enabled fallback routing to model-compat-small, cache-warm started, per-tenant burst throttle created, relaxed sticky sessions for region fallback
- current status: p95 back to baseline, p99 ~1.0-1.2s, still stabilizing, no customer data loss. monitored endpoints: hosted-api-prod, kvcache-shard-17, autoscaler-g4-us-west
- actions pending: confirm cache warm completes (30–60m), verify quota backfill, confirm customer throttled by account team (CS owning outreach)

anika: taking over monitoring. i'll keep incident open and update periodic status. handoff notes: watch p99 and autoscaler error rate >0.1%. add-on: notify infra if autoscaler errors reappear.

sara_cs: CS: customer A acknowledged mitigation and will pause ingestion job; they asked for follow-up once fully resolved.

mike_w: logs show no new large batches after throttle applied. p99 currently 0.98s.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident INC-202303-8942 marked as monitoring-by-oncall (anika). Next update in 30m or sooner if regression.

anika: handing off to next rotation (jules_ml) at 13:00 UTC. leaving runbook link and short checklist: 1) confirm cache_warm finished 2) watch for autoscaler quota refill 3) revert sticky-session relaxed patch once stable 4) file follow-up postmortem if customer impact > 5% of requests in 1h. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-kvcache

jules_ml: acked, i'll take next shift. thanks team. :thumbsup:
